parameter.help: A shipped config profile to run with instead of `config` (knobs and plan): base, exp, best, klusters. Unset: `config`, else the session folder's fiber-kit.yaml.

The fiber-kit.yaml the recluster runs with (knobs AND plan), whatever session is open. `fk install klusters-plugin` sets it to the fiber-kit-klusters.yaml it installs beside this descriptor: the tuned profile made session-agnostic for a sub-session (no chunk selection, no resume, no fixed variant, no QC report). Edit that file to change what Klusters runs; clear this to use the session folder's fiber-kit.yaml instead.
A plan yaml to run instead of the config's pipeline: section.
Waveform variant for the run. %variant = the open clustering's (Klusters substitutes it); or a token such as stderiv; unset: the config's / the session's.

program.help: Run the fiber-kit pipeline on the selected clusters' spikes and replace them with its clusters. The plan and knobs come from `config` (the fiber-kit-klusters.yaml installed beside this descriptor; edit it to change what Klusters runs) or the `profile` chosen here; the session folder's fiber-kit.yaml only when both are unset. The result is integrated as a recluster (one undo step); in a hierarchical session a plan ending on a hierarchy also installs its atoms.
